unit_population: first exposure of each distinct rg/grep search output >= 512 bytes

conditions.B: current search-query relevance only, using the same V3 routing seam but no prior trajectory identifiers
conditions.C: same current search-query relevance as B plus frozen V3 prior-tool trajectory context

historical_critical_oracle: non-empty parent-version production lines within +/-5 lines of each source fix hunk; historical-fix-adjacent, not causal ground truth
validity_gate: A replay must reproduce captured upstream KEEP/DROP decisions for every parsed record in the search unit
primary_metrics: historical-fix-adjacent records retained per 1000 non-fix-adjacent retained record tokens
interpretation_limits: non-fix-adjacent does not mean semantically irrelevant
B and C are exploratory counterfactual variants, not frozen production V3
task success is not re-estimated because no agent is rerun
primary trajectory-value claim comes from B versus C, since both receive identical current search intent
